title: Manual workout
intro: Choose what you want to do today and start at your own pace.
rehabHint: Please consult a qualified professional first.
local: Local candidates use your confirmed place, equipment and cautions. Search filters stay unchanged.
noPlan: No plan yet. Choose a few exercises to begin.
noMatch: No exercises match. Try another word or clear the filters.
caution: Related to an area you flagged. Read the exercise notes first.
prefill: Your place and equipment from onboarding are filled in. You can change them.
helpEmpty: No local selection is available with these filters. Adjust them or choose exercises yourself.
adultRequired: Local suggestions are available after confirming you are 18 or older. You can still choose exercises yourself.
placeRequired: Choose where you will train before requesting a local selection.
manualDefaults: Switched to a manual workout with 2 sets per exercise.
planTargets: This session keeps its planned sets and targets. Adding or removing exercises switches to a manual workout.
candidateHint: This only prepares a manual workout; your plan stays unchanged. Adding or removing exercises resets each exercise to 2 sets.
candidateReady: Workout selected. Review it before starting.
clearSearchHint: Clearing filters also clears the search text. Selected exercises stay selected.
